AccessLevel.description: How much a key can do against one service. UNKNOWN means undetermined.
AccessLevel.title: AccessLevel

Capability.description: A single confirmed capability: one service the key can reach, at a known access level, with evidence proving it.

service.description: Reachable service, e.g. 'Gemini Files API', 'S3', 'Stripe Charges'.
service.title: Service

access.description: Confirmed access level. UNKNOWN when no rule could decide.

detail.description: What the key can do here, e.g. 'Can list uploaded files'.
detail.title: Detail

evidence.description: Masked request plus a benign response summary proving the access. Never contains an unmasked key unless --unmask was passed.
evidence.title: Evidence

risk_weight.description: Plugin-declared base risk for this capability, 0-100.
risk_weight.title: Risk Weight

data_sensitive.description: Reaches private or user data (records, files, messages, PII)?
data_sensitive.title: Data Sensitive

incurs_cost.description: Can spend money or send communications (inference, cloud, SMS)?
incurs_cost.title: Incurs Cost

restricted.description: Did a referrer, IP or app restriction appear to block real use of this capability? Lowers severity when it holds for every capability, since such restrictions are often bypassable.
restricted.title: Restricted

resource_ref.description: Specific resource this capability reaches, if identified.
resource_ref.title: Resource Ref

poc.description: Safe, read-only proof-of-concept command for the report.
poc.title: Poc

Capability.title: Capability

Identity.description: Account identity behind the key, as far as the provider discloses it. Every field is optional.

owner.description: Owning user or team, where exposed.
owner.title: Owner

plan_or_tier.description: Billing plan or tier, which often bounds the blast radius.
plan_or_tier.title: Plan Or Tier

extra.description: Provider-specific identity details. Values are strings so the report renders and serializes deterministically; convert at the provider boundary rather than storing mixed types here.
extra.title: Extra

Identity.title: Identity

Severity.description: Computed severity band, from the confirmed capabilities alone.
Severity.title: Severity

ValidationResult.description: Outcome of the liveness check: whether the provider accepted the key, and any identity it disclosed.

valid.description: Did the provider accept this key?
valid.title: Valid

identity.description: Identity, when the validation call exposed one.

note.description: Human-readable qualifier — why a key was rejected, or which restriction (referrer/IP/app) appears to be in force.
note.title: Note

ValidationResult.title: ValidationResult

description: A keyreach finding: what an exposed API key can reach, its computed severity, the evidence behind each capability, and how to remediate.

schema_version.description: Report schema version. Bumped on any breaking shape change.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

generated_at.description: When this report was produced. Timezone-aware and engine-injected; the only field that legitimately varies between identical runs.
generated_at.title: Generated At

key_fingerprint.description: Masked key, e.g. 'AIza****************************3xY'. The full secret appears only when --unmask is passed.
key_fingerprint.title: Key Fingerprint

severity_rationale.description: The specific confirmed capabilities that produced the band. This is the bounty argument, and what lets a triager verify the claim.
severity_rationale.title: Severity Rationale

capabilities.description: Confirmed capabilities, stably sorted by service then access.
capabilities.title: Capabilities

notes.description: What could not be determined: probe failures, and why nothing was probed when nothing was. An empty list means the run was clean, not that the capability map is exhaustive.
notes.title: Notes

title: Report
